on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

      - .github/actions/setup/action.yml
      - .github/workflows/test.yml
      - Justfile
      - crates/**
      - tests/**

      - tools/release.py
      - Cargo.lock

      - pyproject.toml
      - noxfile.py
      - mise.toml
      - rust-toolchain.toml
      - uv.lock
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - .github/actions/setup/action.yml
      - .github/workflows/test.yml
      - Justfile
      - crates/**
      - tests/**
      - tools/corpus-python.sh
      - tools/release.py
      - Cargo.lock
      - Cargo.toml
      - pyproject.toml
      - noxfile.py
      - mise.toml
      - rust-toolchain.toml
      - uv.lock
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      os:
        description: Comma-delineated list of OS targets to run tests on
        required: false
        type: string
      ref:
        description: Git ref to test
        required: false
        type: string
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      os:
        description: Comma-delineated list of OS targets to run tests on
        required: false
        type: string

concurrency:
  group: test-${{ inputs.ref || github.ref }}
  # Runs on main finish so they can save the caches pull requests restore.
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  FORCE_COLOR: "1"
  PYTHONUNBUFFERED: "1"
  UV_CACHE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.cache/uv

permissions: {}

jobs:
  should-run:
    if: "${{ github.event_name != 'push' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') || !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, ':bookmark: bump version') }}"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: true

  generate-matrix:
    needs: [should-run]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.set-matrix.outputs.matrix }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup
        with:
          tools: uv just
          uv-cache-key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-uv-matrix-${{ hashFiles('uv.lock', 'mise.toml', 'noxfile.py') }}

      - id: set-matrix
        env:
          INPUT_OS: ${{ inputs.os }}
          BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          os="$INPUT_OS"
          if [[ -z "$os" && "$BRANCH" == release/* ]]; then
            os="macos-latest,ubuntu-latest,windows-latest"
          fi
          just gha-matrix "$os"

  test:
    name: Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}, Django ${{ matrix.django-version }} (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: generate-matrix
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.generate-matrix.outputs.matrix) }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}
          persist-credentials: false

      # The legs differ only in Python and Django, so they share one Rust cache and one uv
      # cache per OS. The first leg saves them.
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup
        with:
          tools: uv rust just
          save: ${{ strategy.job-index == 0 }}
          rust-cache: test
          uv-cache-key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-uv-test

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
